clips.title: The story
paras: Great-father Winter waits in Orgrimmar to thank those who recovered Smokywood Pastures' stolen holiday treats. Kaymard Copperpinch sends you to receive a token of appreciation for bringing the supplies back.

In Orgrimmar, Smokywood Pastures sells treats, recipes, and seasonal cheer for the Feast of Winter Veil. Their shipment was stolen in the snowy hills of the Alterac Mountains, and business stalled. With the treats recovered and the Abominable Greench dealt with, Kaymard Copperpinch sends you to receive the company's thanks.

Great-father Winter waits beside the holiday tree in the Valley of Strength. The goblins have arranged for him to honor those who rescued the holiday supplies with a seasonal blessing and a Smokywood Pastures Special Gift.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We at Smokywood Pastures appreciate the recovery of the stolen treats, friend. For that, we'd like to offer you a special gift... Presented by none other than Great-father Winter himself!

Please, speak with Great-father Winter, and he will give you your Feast of Winter Veil gift from us here at Smokywood Pastures. From our farm to your plate, it's always Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness... Thanks to you, of course!

clips.title: Completion
paras: The goblins told me that you have earned a special gift this holiday season, and I am pleased to give it to you. Here you go - have a wondrous Feast of Winter Veil this and every season in the future.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
